name: Capmatinib
drugClass: Selective MET tyrosine kinase inhibitor (type Ib)
mechanism: Highly selective, reversible type Ib inhibitor binding the active conformation of the MET kinase, used for MET exon 14 skipping NSCLC.
keyToxicities: Serum creatinine increase (partly from inhibition of renal tubular transporters)
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A inducers. May increase exposure of P-gp, BCRP and CYP1A2 substrates.
resistance: MET kinase-domain mutations (D1228X, Y1230X) affecting type I inhibitors; MET amplification; bypass signalling via KRAS, EGFR or PI3K pathway.
